assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape 3:2 editorial news cover, clearly an illustration, not a photograph or factual data visualization. Create a refined textured editorial illustration about manufacturing production planning: stylized industrial machinery and conveyor components, with a small stack of completely blank order sheets integrated naturally in the foreground. Restrained warm terracotta and cool slate-blue business-news palette, subtle paper grain, strong clear shapes and thoughtful lighting. Central crop-safe composition with breathing room so subject survives wide article-card crops. Professional, understated, not dramatic collapse or boom. No people required. Absolutely no text, letters, numerals, symbols, charts, graphs, plotted lines, arrows, gauges with values, logos, brands, flags or political elements. Do not represent any actual factory or news event. Wide landscape.
